turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Don't thank me, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
You still haven't told me whether Owen was heard first, and I'm writing that down. Show me this version history, dates and times on the screen where I can read them myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale, cc Principal, Elbow Crossing High School. Tuesday, November 10.
We agreed to nothing at today's meeting.
You did not tell me whether Owen was heard before the zero was entered, and nobody called me first, contrary to procedure 4.2.
You said you wanted to walk me through the version history; I asked to see it with dates and times and was not shown it.
I want that document, a written answer on whether Owen was heard first, the zero withdrawn, and written confirmation that nothing is on his record.
I expect all of it by Thursday, November 12, or I will ask the principal to review this under procedure 4.6.
Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, and she agreed to nothing.
Moved at: "I want to walk you through what I found in the version history."
Slipped at: "Thanks for coming in."
